verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented employee-facing feature that explains equity in plain language, including tax treatment, exercise windows or dilution. Vesting email alerts and the bare 'Interactive offer letters' pricing line are adjacent at most: they notify or present offers but are not shown to explain these concepts. The 83(b) tracker is an admin cap-table tool, not employee education.

support.subject: As an employee, the platform explains my equity in plain language — tax treatment, exercise windows, dilution — not just numbers
